Auto Defect Management System

01 / Context

The problem

Automated test runs can generate repeated failures that require manual investigation and duplicate bug reports. The system addresses the work between observing a failed test and producing a useful issue for triage.

My contribution

Hands-on development of the evidence collection mechanism, automated duplicate-checking logic, and the script-healing and logging framework connecting the test and issue-management workflows.

02 / Workflow

From input to outcome

  1. Capture an execution failure

    Collect failures from Eggplant automation runs.

  2. Gather evidence

    Collect diagnostic context for the failed execution.

  3. Check existing issues

    Compare against existing Jira tickets before reporting a new issue.

  4. Structure a new report

    Format a clean Jira ticket for a genuinely new issue.

03 / Architecture

Implementation boundaries

Test execution boundary

Eggplant supplies automated-test execution failures to the integration workflow.

Evidence and duplicate checks

Diagnostic evidence collection and automated checks against existing Jira tickets support the triage workflow. The public summary does not specify the duplicate-matching algorithm.

Jira logging and issue tracking

The system connects automated-test logging with Jira issue tracking.

Script-maintenance bridge

The logging and healing framework connects this workflow to Script Change Management. The two case studies describe distinct responsibilities within the connected work.

  • Eggplant
  • Jira
  • Evidence collection
  • Duplicate checks

04 / Engineering decisions

Controls and trade-offs

Check before reporting

Existing Jira tickets are checked before a new defect report is created, with the aim of avoiding duplicate issue clutter.

Collect context at the failure boundary

Evidence collection is part of the integration workflow so that new issue reports can carry diagnostic context.

Connect reporting to script maintenance

The healing and logging framework provides a bridge from defect-management work to the connected Script Change Management system.

05 / Status and evidence

Internal-system scope and evidence

An internal integration tool connecting test execution, diagnostic evidence and Jira reporting. The disclosed contribution covers evidence collection, duplicate checks and the healing/logging framework; deployment scale and measured business impact are not included.

Employer code, ticket examples and test artifacts remain confidential under NDA. The public evidence is this sanitized workflow and contribution summary.
